title: Cross-model mechanistic divergence map (observational)
description: clozn.analysis.mechanistic_diff's output: WHERE two pair-compatible model executions differ internally over the SAME teacher-forced continuation, at a configurable layer/position grid. This slice is purely OBSERVATIONAL -- it contains no causal claim about why a divergence exists, only where and how large it measures as. A metric that could not be honestly computed (a layer the engine could not capture, a position outside the scored continuation, a token absent from a returned top-k list) is OMITTED from the relevant `metrics` object and named in that entry's `omitted` list with a reason -- never a zero standing in for 'no divergence'.

model_ref.description: Identifying facts about one side of the pair, mirroring clozn.pair-compatibility.v1's own model_ref (this document embeds that contract's model_a/model_b verbatim as reference_model/candidate_model, so a stored diff is self-describing without a second lookup).

metric_omission.description: One metric that could not be honestly computed at this point, and why. Never paired with a same-named key in the sibling `metrics` object -- a metric is either present with a value or named here, never both.

tensor_ref.description: A content-addressed reference into clozn.analysis.tensor_store -- the raw captured residual row backing a residual_points entry, for a later slice (or a human) to re-inspect.

layer_capture_entry.description: Per requested layer, whether each side's engine actually captured it. A layer can be within a model's writable [1, n_layer) range and still capture nothing -- the known case is the last layer (n_layer-1): llama.cpp's inp_out_ids optimization only materializes logit rows there, so a whole-sequence capture request for it is always empty. `note` explains a False -- never left for the reader to guess.

position_metrics_fields.description: Layer-invariant per-position quantities read off each model's own /score output distribution at that continuation position (not a per-layer readout -- see the module docstring). 'logit_delta' is computed from the log-softmax value the wire protocol actually returns (a monotonic transform of the true logit, not the raw pre-softmax logit itself, which the wire format does not expose), always as candidate-minus-reference. 'rank_movement' is rank_under_candidate minus rank_under_reference (positive = the token fell in relative rank under the candidate).

residual_metrics_fields.description: residual_cosine_similarity: cosine of the two captured residual rows, clipped to [-1, 1]. residual_l2_normalized: ||reference - candidate|| / ((||reference|| + ||candidate||) / 2) -- the raw L2 distance divided by the pair's average magnitude, so the number stays comparable across layers whose typical residual norm differs (early layers are small, late layers large).

layer_change_entry.description: How much ONE model's own residual changed between two consecutive entries of the requested layer grid, at one position -- a within-model depth-wise reading, never a cross-model comparison (see residual_point for that).

pair_compatibility.description: The full clozn.pair-compatibility.v1 document that gated this capture, embedded verbatim -- a stored diff is self-describing about what compatibility was actually confirmed before it was produced.

layer_change.description: Optional -- present only when at least two requested layers were captured for the same model at the same position, giving at least one consecutive pair to compare.
